evidence_rules: 1955–1958 is an explicitly low-confidence pre-association baseline derived from the ITF-recorded 1959 foundation year.
The 1959 association foundation and 2012 OTF membership are separately time-gated.
The 2024 East Pacific junior pathway is development/competition evidence, not a senior-player outcome target.
The 2026 OTF profile, including a development officer, is current-only.
No ranking or junior result is used as a calibration target.
